text:
maria.gonzalez: Heads up — getting a flood of customer tickets about 401s since ~17:02 UTC. Users hitting the hosted API with valid keys getting "token expired" and "invalid signature" errors. Not seeing a clear pattern by region yet. Anyone oncall?

sre-oncall: I'm here. Can you paste a sample request/response? Any correlation with model endpoints vs embeddings?

maria.gonzalez: Most reports from text-generation endpoints, some embeddings. Example from support ticket: 

```
POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer rwd_live_XX...
Response 401 {"error":"token_invalid","detail":"signature mismatch"}
```

No recent deploys from our side that should affect auth.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: key-rotator job started by CI at 2026-11-03T16:50:12Z (rev abc123) 

devon: Checking auth-service logs now. I see the key-rotation background job spiked and then a follow-up flood of rejects. KV propagation to the verifier pool is lagging — some verifier nodes still using previous key, others ahead.

kevin_liu: Can you dump verifier health? Also any DB write errors when publishing new keys to keyring?

devon: Pasting log excerpt: 

```
[16:50:14] key-rotator: publish key id=k_20261103_rev1 -> write ok
[16:50:15] key-propagator: queued 45 verifier nodes
[16:50:16] verifier-7: warn: failed to reload keyset: timeout talking to config-store (503)
[16:50:18] verifier-2: info: reload complete using k_20261103_rev1
[16:50:19] verifier-7: error: signature_check failed for token id=tok_... err=key_not_found
```

So it's an inconsistent propagation window — caused mixed verification state -> intermittent signature mismatch.

ashley: Is this the same rotation flow we've used before? Any config change to propagation retries or batch size?

devon: We increased parallelism last week to speed up rollouts (PR #4421). That change added a concurrent publisher and we hit a transient 503 from config-store which left a subset of verifiers behind.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Roll back to previous keyset (stop using new signing key for outgoing tokens), 2) Pause client-side rotation acceptance to allow all verifiers to converge, 3) Requeue propagation with slower rate. Prefer 1+3. Thoughts?

kevin_liu: I can flip a config flag to allow fallback to prior key for verification (should be fast). Doing it now.

kevin_liu: ```
# toggle fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/keys/fallback -d '{"enable":true}'
```

support-bot: Notifying support, setting ticket label auth-incident, ETA message to affected users: "We're investigating auth errors; a mitigation is in progress."

maria.gonzalez: Thanks. Any impact on Dedicated/Private customers? I've flagged enterprise tickets.

devon: Dedicated clusters unaffected (they receive keys via separate stream). Private customers: depends on whether they use hosted key-propagation. CS will follow up.

samir: I'm running a requeue to replay propagation to verifiers with retries at 10s interval. Command: `key-propagator --requeue --concurrency=4 --retry-interval=10s`

ops-bot: key-rotator: rollback endpoint triggered by kevin_liu at 16:52:03Z (rollback to k_20261027_rev4)

maria.gonzalez: Error rate dropping in SLO dashboard from 7% -> 2.5% over last 5m. Seeing some customers still reporting 401s though.

ashley: We should also clear any long-lived KV caches on verifier nodes so stale keys aren't served. I'll roll a cache eviction across the pool (rolling).

ashley: `kubectl -n auth rollout restart deploy/verifier --field-selector=metadata.name=verifier-` (doing a 10% batch)

devon: Propagation finished at 16:55:44Z per logs. All verifiers report keyset with both current and previous keys present. Error rate down to 0.8% now.

maria.gonzalez: Support pushed an update to affected customers and set expectation. Opening an incident postmortem ticket.

sre-oncall: Root cause summary for postmortem draft: increased parallelism in propagation + transient config-store 503 caused partial propagation -> signature mismatch on subset of verifier pool -> 401s for some requests. Mitigation: enable fallback to prior key, requeue propagation with backoff, evict verifier caches.

ashley: Action items (short-term): revert the parallelism change on rotation flow, add a propagation consistency check before marking rotation complete, add alert on verifier-keyset-drift.

kevin_liu: I'll also add a canary window: require 99.9% verifier convergence for 2 minutes before issuing new tokens.

maria.gonzalez: Creating follow-up tasks and owner assignments in incident board. Thanks all — keeping channel open for any regressions. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20261103-0042. Assigned to maria.gonzalez and devon.

samir: Observability note: add a metric for key-propagation-lag_ms and a histogram for verifier reload latency.

sre-oncall: Closing this thread as mitigated; will reopen if error rate climbs.

maria.gonzalez: Thanks team. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow."
